ios.daily: DeviceActivityData.activityData filtered daily requested interval using .live. Positive app totalActivityDuration grouped by lowercase bundleidentifier, Mac vs mobile model classification; optional displayName. Positive web domains grouped separately. Raw milliseconds Double from source seconds; native rounded Int minutes, JS daily provider prefers raw ms and returns fractional minutes. Duration descending then targetID ordering. No opaque token serialized by this data-access path.
ios.hourly: Detailed .hourly segments produce application/webDomain records with segment start/end Double Unix ms, total durationMs, rounded minutes, category/deviceName/deviceModel plus application pickups/notifications. These are bucket boundaries and counts, never launch/close sessions. No record UUID, original device installation identity, lastUpdatedDate/source completeness or source query receipt persisted.
ios.device_identity: Daily sourceMinutes collapses all devices to mac/mobile per app. Detailed deviceName/model are descriptive, not durable unique source IDs. No data.user/lastUpdatedDate retained. Multiple-device overlap cannot be admitted as a single-device timeline.
